_about: Advertised offers read from each business's own site. One row per listing. valid_until is the end date the site states, or empty when it states none (Offers\sweep removes a row the day after it ends; re-check undated rows monthly). The structured fields (kind, price, basis, includes, eligibility, terms) are what the listing card shows -- only state what the site states; price is a display string, never computed. Set removed:true to clear a row. Filter fields, also only from what the site states: activities (any of yoga, pilates, spa, sauna, massage, fitness, beauty -- what the offer is for, not everything the venue does; [] when it is none of them, e.g. a retreat); format (pass = access for a set number of days, pack = a set number of sessions or classes, single = one visit or treatment, package = several treatments in one visit, discount = money or percent off, or buy-x-get-y); amount (the AUD total payable up front for the offer as stated, 0 for free, or null when it depends on what is booked -- never computed from a percentage); audience (new = the site restricts it to new or first-time customers, anyone = the site says anyone can buy it, empty = not stated); days (for a pass, the number of days it runs, as stated); renewal (only if the site states what happens after the offer, e.g. a membership it rolls into). Applied by tools/apply-offers.php or Listings > Offers import.
